title: WORK-LAB local model benchmark — measured on this machine, 2026-09-28

machine.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060, 8151 MiB VRAM, driver 595.97, compute capability 12.0
machine.os_build: Windows (C: 241.6 GB free, D: 129.5 GB free at start)
machine.note: Only ~1.1 GiB of VRAM was free because the desktop session holds ~6.8 GiB. That single fact dominates every number below.

cold_start_seconds_to_health.note: second value is a warm OS page cache

deep_model.offload_finding: GPU offload of 8 of ~64 layers buys only ~+10% generation and no prompt-processing gain, because only 1.1 GiB of VRAM is free. The model is effectively CPU-bound on this machine while the desktop holds the GPU.
deep_model.thinking_mode_finding: Qwen3.8 is a reasoning model: with thinking enabled the token budget is consumed by reasoning_content and visible content stays empty. chat_template_kwargs {enable_thinking:false} (or /no_think) must be set by the caller; measured reasoning_chars=0 and a complete answer once disabled.
deep_model.real_answer_sample: 1. 降低存储成本与硬件压力… 2. 简化版本管理与一致性… 3. 提升部署与更新效率…

measured.note: cold, first request, CPU fallback because only 1.1 GiB VRAM was free

fast_model.thinking_mode_finding: Qwen3.5 is also a reasoning model; without enable_thinking:false the visible content is empty (finish_reason=length). Set it explicitly.
fast_model.quality_sample_zh: Reranker 的作用是显著减少把大量低相关 chunk 塞给大模型，从而降低 context token、推理时间与本地模型负载。

robustness.oom: No CUDA OOM observed: with only 1.1 GiB free the runtime fell back to CPU instead of over-committing VRAM. A true OOM was not reproducible without an app holding the GPU.

headline.deep_dense_27b_on_this_box: runs correctly at ~2.5 tok/s; usable for batch/long-form work, slow for interactive chat
headline.gpu_free_retest: After the desktop's GPU footprint was released (VRAM used 6.8 -> 2.0 GiB, free 1.1 -> 5.9 GiB): DEEP ngl=32 reaches 20.10 prompt / 2.52 gen tok/s and FAST ngl=99 reaches 114.20 prompt / 10.81 gen tok/s.

gpu_free_retest.context: User closed the programs that were holding the GPU; re-measured 2026-09-28.
gpu_free_retest.gpu_state_before_retest: total 8151 MiB, used 2009 MiB, free 5887 MiB
gpu_free_retest.analysis: Freeing the GPU lifted DEEP generation 1.32 -> 2.52 tok/s (+91%) and prompt processing 14.54 -> 20.10 (+38%), and it is flat from ngl 16 to 32 (diminishing returns: ~222 MB of weights per layer, only about a third of the model fits in 8 GiB). The dense 27B is therefore memory-bandwidth bound on 64 GB DDR4-3600: its 13.27 GB at roughly 38 GB/s gives a ceiling near 2.7 tok/s, and 2.52 is about 93% of that. FAST, which genuinely fits in the card, went 8.04 -> 10.81 gen tok/s with 114.20 prompt tok/s.
gpu_free_retest.headroom: DEEP cannot get materially faster on this machine without a smaller quant or a larger GPU; the effective lever would be a model that fits entirely in 8 GiB (roughly an 8B class). FAST is now comfortably interactive.
